subject: What's the best way to calculate predictions (including random effects and spatial spde) based a new data set and inla model?

messages.author: 929e733ff7821ad3
messages.subject: What's the best way to calculate predictions (including random effects and spatial spde) based a new data set and inla model?
parts:
Dear all,

I have runned a model including random effect and spatial spde. Now I would like to calculate the predictions on a new dataset, including the random effect and spatial effects. I havent figured out an efficient way to do it. What's the best way to do it, without wasting time in estimating the model again?

Thanks

Regards,
Chun

messages.author: 9940b4fcc153c7d7
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] What's the best way to calculate predictions (including random effects and spatial spde) based a new data set and inla model?
parts:
"Best" is a computational effort vs human time question:

Short computations: Posterior simulations and predicting based on these.
Low human effort: Fake NA data, refit the model.

Best,
Haakon
